# OpenLayers 10.7.0

Unmodified offline distribution from the official OpenLayers GitHub release:

Source: https://github.com/openlayers/openlayers/releases/download/v10.7.0/v10.7.0-package.zip

The archive's dist/ol.js, ol.css and LICENSE.md are distributed here.
Verify with sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS in this directory. No CDN or build step is used.
